name: Touch Typing Trainer DE
author: EchoGrav (German fork of Anton Milman's Touch Typing Trainer)
description: German (QWERTZ) clone of the Touch Typing Trainer plugin. Touch (Blind) typing in the age of AI, is hugely overrated, but if you want to go old-school and actually use a keyboard, you better be quick. Enjoy training Touch Typing using this plugin while your agent is writing your code.

barWidget.description: Level and streak indicator; click to open the trainer
